Character assets — source, rights, and changes
Retrieved: 25 September 2026. No registration or paid resource was required.

MakeHuman Community's MakeHuman core output and system assets are CC0:
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/makehuman/faq/are_makehuman_files_free.html
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/makehuman_system_assets.html
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Selected source items include the base adult human, skin, eyes, eyebrows,
eyelashes, short hair, male_casualsuit02, shoes01 and shoes04. Original selected
asset files are retained in source/selected_assets/.

The contact's double-breasted suit is Margaret Toigo's asset from the CC0
Suits 01 pack:
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/suits01.html
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The MPFB 2.0.17 Blender extension was used only while authoring. It is
GPL-3.0-or-later and is not in the repository or game package:
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/mpfb/docs/getting_started.html

Changes: The contact suit and shoes were recolored to muted brown, skin was
adjusted, and a relaxed idle pose was baked. The guard uses a fitted plain
gray-green field shirt and trousers with the modern logo removed, black shoes,
and no insignia. Both arms were posed for the low-ready Sten. MakeHuman's
masked helper and hidden clothing-body faces were evaluated away before
export; two visible-mesh walking morphs were baked. The runtime guard is a
static mesh plus stride morphs, not a skeletal animation. The scout uses a
separate muted khaki recolor and relaxed pose. These are fictional visual
costumes, not reconstructions of a named military uniform or faction.

Editable Blender files are retained in source/ beside the derived textures;
runtime/ contains the Godot GLBs and textures. Full download archives and
the authoring extension remain only in the Git-ignored reference/ directory.

26 September 2026: guard_field_locomotion.blend and guard_field_animated.glb
derive solely from the retained guard_field_grip.blend and the same CC0 input
assets. The selected MakeHuman body proportions were frozen, concealed helper
and under-clothing faces were removed using the original masks, and the 53-bone
rig and mesh weights were retained. GuardIdle and an in-place GuardWalk were
authored locally; no third-party animation was imported. The earlier
guard_field_morph.glb remains as comparison evidence.
